text: 近段时间，公私募机构频繁出手自购，以真金白银传递对中国资本市场长期健康稳定发展的信心。据记者不完全统计，10月公募基金自购金额合计已超过20亿元，主动ETF成为其重要载体。另外，中欧瑞博、凯丰投资等百亿私募也在近期自购旗下权益类产品。在业内人士看来，近期稳市场举措密集落地，与公私募自购形成政策与资金共振，进一步夯实市场内在稳定机制、增强市场韧性与信心。（经济参考报）
text_en: Recently, public and private fund institutions have frequently made self-purchases, using real money to convey confidence in the long-term healthy and stable development of China's capital market. According to an incomplete count by the reporter, public fund self-purchases totaled more than 2 billion yuan in October, with active ETFs becoming an important vehicle. In addition, 10-billion-yuan private funds such as China Europe Ruibo and Capstone Investment also recently purchased their own equity products. Industry insiders believe that the intensive rollout of market-stabilizing measures recently, together with self-purchases by public and private funds, has created a resonance between policy and capital, further consolidating the market's internal stabilization mechanism and enhancing market resilience and confidence. (Economic Information Daily)
